subject: Initiate security questionnaire & evidence map — BrightPath Health (post-call follow-up)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate security questionnaire & evidence map — BrightPath Health (post-call follow-up)

Hi Maria,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through BrightPath's use case. As promised, I wanted to capture the security/compliance next steps so your security team can begin a formal intake. High level from our call: BrightPath will evaluate Redwood for chat summarization features that will process PHI. You mentioned HIPAA coverage, SOC 2 attestation, and a preference for a questionnaire format you can complete online.

To move forward, could you confirm the following so we can route the right intake and evidence?

- Preferred questionnaire format: CAIQ (Cloud Controls Matrix / CAIQ), SIG Lite, or a custom Excel?
- Do you require a signed BAA before we proceed with any live testing (we have a standard BAA and can provide it for review)?
- SOC 2 Type: do you require Type II within the last 12 months?
- Data residency / controls: will BrightPath insist on US-only processing or require EU data residency?
- Any mandatory third-party attestations (e.g., FedRAMP, HITRUST) beyond SOC 2/HIPAA?

I've attached a one-page context sheet to speed your team: BrightPath_Security_Context.xlsx (stub). If CAIQ is preferred, our security engineer will send a prefilled CAIQ baseline and an evidence map to speed things up.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm preferred questionnaire and whether a BAA is required (reply by EOD Apr 7 if possible)
- If CAIQ/SIG: we'll share a prefilled sheet and a checklist of evidence we can provide
- If custom: please attach your template and we’ll map evidence to controls

Thanks — looping in Monica (solutions) to help with the intake and Evelyn (security) for technical evidence.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightPath_Security_Context.xlsx (spreadsheet, stub)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Security Team <sec-team@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiate security questionnaire & evidence map — BrightPath Health (post-call follow-up)

Hi Karthik — thanks for the recap and the context sheet. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Questionnaire preference: Prefer CAIQ to start (our security ops uses CAIQ as the canonical intake). If Redwood has a prefilled CAIQ baseline, that will speed review.
- BAA: Yes, we require a signed BAA prior to any environment where PHI is processed. Please send your standard BAA and any timelines for execution.
- SOC 2: We require a SOC 2 Type II report within the last 12 months. If you can provide a summary and the auditor name, that helps our vendor risk team.
- Data residency: US-only processing is acceptable for this engagement; we don't have an EU-data requirement for this project.
- Additional attestations: Not required at this time.

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood maintains an inventory of subprocessors and whether encryption at rest keys are customer-managed or platform-managed?

Attaching: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf (stub) — this is a redacted summary we can share publicly.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Vendor Security
BrightPath Health

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf (pdf, stub)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initiate security questionnaire & evidence map — BrightPath Health (post-call follow-up)

Thanks — reviewed Maria's replies and the SOC snapshot. A few clarifying asks from security before we hand a prefilled CAIQ back to them: 

1) BAA: we have a standard BAA; Legal will prepare a version for Maria. Monica / Karthik, please confirm if the customer needs any contract redlines in advance.
2) Subprocessors: BrightPath asked for an inventory. We can provide a current subprocessors.csv export and a short narrative describing contract terms and location of processing.
3) Encryption: platform-managed keys (KMS) by default; we support customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private only. Need to confirm whether BrightPath expects CMK for this project.
4) Evidence map: I'll prepare a CAIQ prefill for common high-risk controls (HIPAA overlap) and an evidence mapping sheet listing typical artifacts we can provide (attestation letters, config screenshots, policy docs, SSO logs, retention policy).

Please confirm the following so I can scope the evidence pack:
- Target review window (how fast do they expect turnaround? E.g., 10 business days)
- Any specific retention periods for PHI they enforce beyond our standard 90-day logs request
- Whether they need penetration test reports / red-team artifacts or a summarized vulnerability management statement

I'll attach the evidence map and a prefill draft when ready. Suggest we propose a single consolidated CAIQ upload to BrightPath's portal rather than sending many small files.

Evelyn Hart
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this internal note

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiate security questionnaire & evidence map — BrightPath Health (post-call follow-up)

Hi Maria — thanks for confirming. Quick summary and proposed next steps so everyone's aligned: 

Summary answers:
- Questionnaire: we'll produce a prefilled CAIQ baseline and upload to your portal (per your preference).
- BAA: legal will send our standard BAA today for your review; if you have redlines please flag them in the next 5 business days.
- SOC 2: Evelyn will provide the redacted summary we already have (attached to this thread) and the auditor name.
- Subprocessors: we'll include our current subprocessors list and a short narrative.
- Encryption: platform-managed KMS by default; if you require CMK we can discuss Dedicated/Private options and an implementation timeline.

Proposed timeline / asks:
- Apr 9: We will upload the prefilled CAIQ and the evidence map to the Drive link below.
- Apr 14: Please confirm acceptance of the BAA or provide redlines by this date so testing can proceed.
- Please let us know if BrightPath needs penetration test artifacts — otherwise we'll provide a vulnerability management statement and high-level remediation cadence.

Action items for Maria / BrightPath:
- Confirm whether CAIQ upload to your portal is OK (yes/no)
- Confirm whether you need CMK or platform keys
- Provide a single contact for legal redlines (name + email)

Drive (shared): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBrightPathShared
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If that looks good I'll have Evelyn attach the evidence pack and Monica will coordinate any contractual next steps.

Best regards,

Karthik Iyer
